name: dev.patchlabs/patchlabs
title: PatchLabs
description: Finds personal-data leaks in Supabase/Lovable apps: free RLS and headers checks, proven fixes.

tools.name: rls_check
tools.description: Free, no sign-up. Reads a public GitHub repo's supabase/migrations and lists row-level-security mistakes that could let strangers or other users read personal data (findings PL-001..PL-008 and PL-014, each with a fix). Static analysis only: it never connects to the live app or database. Suited to Supabase, Lovable and Bolt repos.

repo.description: Public GitHub repo, e.g. owner/name or https://github.com/owner/name

tools.name: headers_check
tools.description: Grade a public site's HTTPS, TLS certificate, security headers and cookie flags from one load of its home page (no sign-up). Returns findings PL-027..PL-036 and PL-040 (third-party scripts with no CSP limit on where they send data) with fixes.

tools.name: start_check
tools.description: Request the full lab check: the database is rebuilt from the repo with fake rows, leaks are proven as each kind of user, and a tested fix is written. Creates a check and emails the report address; nothing runs until the repo owner proves ownership with a one-line file. Returns a check id and link. Only call when the user asks for the full check and gives their email.

repo.description: Public GitHub repo, e.g. owner/name or https://github.com/owner/name

tools.name: get_check
tools.description: Read one check by id. Read-only, safe to call again to poll. Returns status: awaiting_verification (includes the one-line file the repo owner must add, then nothing runs until they do), queued, running, done, no_leaks, needs_review or failed. When finished it also returns the summary (each finding with severity, CWE/OWASP and days open), the plain-English report (report_md) and the tested fix (fix_sql), plus the event timeline. Use after start_check or run_check; poll every minute or so while queued or running.

check_id.description: The check id that start_check or run_check returned

tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: List the apps monitored in the API key's workspace, each with its id (pass it as app_id to run_check), its last finished check (id and status, for get_check) and any open_check_id. Needs X-API-Key.

tools.name: list_checks
tools.description: List past and running checks for the API key's workspace, newest first, optionally for one app. Each has its id (pass it to get_check for the full report and fix), app_id, client_label, repo, status, trigger (schedule, api, manual), created/finished times and the tables found leaking. Use it to see an app's history or whether a leak came back. Needs X-API-Key.

app_id.description: Optional: only this app's checks (an id from list_apps)

tools.name: run_check
tools.description: Queue a new check for a monitored app now (counts toward the plan's monthly runs). Needs X-API-Key.
